messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

I'm sorry, your order Shop···· hasn't shipped yet. It's paid, and the B30 and Power K. will go out together from our warehouse in Brampton, Ontario. Both are waiting for the next B30 stock to arrive there.

We emailed you on November 3 to say the next batches were rolling out in mid-November. That has slipped. Your B30 is now scheduled to ship with the batch on November 30, and tracking will come to this email as soon as it leaves.

You can follow the batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
